fideon:note: Generated from the supplied dwelling_fire.schema.json v1.4.0 by scripts/build_canonical_policy_schemas.py. Do not hand-edit; edit the source and regenerate. Extended by scripts/canonical_schema_extensions.py with fields the supplied skeleton did not carry; re-run it after any regeneration. Fields carried over from ocean_marine 2026-09-25 (text_sections and printed facts every line of business prints): document.print_time, document.print_code, document.source_url, policy.product_code, policy.policy_period_location_basis, billing.billing_note, billing.payment_coupon_scan_line, billing.phone.

date.note: US insurance documents print dates month/day/year, so every date's parsed value is MM/DD/YYYY: two-digit month and day, four-digit year, whatever the page prints (5/6/26, May 6, 2026 and 2026-05-06 are all parsed as 05/06/2026). raw stays exactly as printed. applies_to matches field names such as effective_date, date_of_birth and replaces_prior_declaration_dated. A form edition_date ("04/07") has no day and keeps its printed form. A value that is not a calendar date ("Full Prior Acts", "None") has parsed null. Compare dates as dates, not strings: as text, 12/31/2025 sorts after 01/01/2026 - this includes the date_ordering audit rules.

additional_fields.description: Printed label/value pairs that have no dedicated field above, kept as key and value: the label as the document prints it, the section heading it sits under, and the value as a FieldValue (raw, parsed, page_ref).

printed_lines.description: Printed lines that no keyed field, label or prose section already carries: section headings, column headers, captions, page headers and footers, empty labels. Together with the keyed fields and text_sections, nothing the page prints is missing from the gold.

parsed.description: The value in its standard form: a number for money and counts, a two-letter code for a state, and MM/DD/YYYY for every date (see fideon:parsed_formats).

TextSection.description: A block of printed text exactly as the document carries it: a prose paragraph, notice, condition or disclaimer, or the page's remaining label/footer text. Nothing the page prints is left out of the gold; structured fields above hold the values, these hold the words.

fideon:local_extensions.note: Added by hand in this repository so every printed section of the dwelling_fire source documents has a home in the canonical schema. Port these into scripts/canonical_schema_extensions.py before regenerating, or a regeneration will drop them. text_sections now holds prose paragraphs only; every labelled value is a keyed field or an additional_fields entry.
fideon:local_extensions.aliases: fideon:aliases completed for every field from the labels printed in the 20 dwelling_fire source PDFs plus industry synonyms.
